runs.title: How do you cancel ChatGPT Plus?
runs.prompt: A user wants to cancel their ChatGPT Plus subscription. Find the exact official steps to cancel, from OpenAI's own sites.
runs.answer: Per OpenAI's official Help Center article "Canceling your ChatGPT subscription," cancel through the platform where you subscribed. Web (chatgpt.com): sign in to ChatGPT, open your account menu > Settings > Billing, then under "Cancel plan" select Cancel. Apple App Store: Settings > [your name] > Subscriptions > ChatGPT > Cancel Subscription, then confirm. Google Play: Play Store app > Subscriptions > ChatGPT > Cancel subscription (or the Play website, next to ChatGPT select Manage > Cancel subscription). Cancel at least 24 hours before your next billing date; paid features remain until the end of the current billing period. Uninstalling the app does not cancel it; deleting your account cancels web-billed subscriptions but not App Store ones.

runs.title: Pick a text-to-speech service for an audiobook
runs.prompt: Someone wants to narrate a 3-hour audiobook with AI voices on roughly a $30/month budget. Visit the candidate sites, compare what you can actually learn from their public pages (pricing, voice quality claims, usage limits), and pick ONE. Candidates: elevenlabs.io, murf.ai, resemble.ai, wellsaidlabs.com.
runs.answer: Pick ElevenLabs on its Creator plan — $22/mo for 121,000 credits (~121 min of text-to-speech, i.e. ~2 hours of audio; extra minutes cost $0.18, and unused credits roll over up to 2 months). A 3-hour audiobook needs roughly 180 minutes/characters, so Creator alone falls ~1 hour short; adding ~$10 of top-ups (or banking one month of rollover) lands you right around the $30 budget, and you also get professional voice cloning plus best-in-class naturalness. Well Said is the most transparent on price but needs its Pro tier for 180 min/month at $49/mo (or $33/mo billed annually) — over budget — while Murf's own pricing page is a JavaScript wall that returns no usable numbers and Resemble's pages wouldn't render, so neither could be verified. If you want the cheapest verified option that comfortably covers the length, ElevenLabs Creator is the one to go with.

Resemble's homepage and /pricing pages returned no readable content (redirect/JS), so I could not confirm any current TTS plans or pricing.
Several pages (ElevenLabs and Well Said pricing, Well Said homepage) were pruned/blank on first fetch and only rendered on a repeat visit, costing extra page loads.
